Subject: Can you provide proof of EU-only inference + SCCs-bound operator controls?

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team needs a short package to satisfy Legal and Procurement before we can sign. Specifically they asked for: 1) a technical runbook or operational playbook that proves inference requests for our tenant will be processed only in EU regions (including failover behavior), 2) confirmation of SCCs in place and any operator access constraints (who can access KVs/logs, under what conditions), and 3) a draft contract clause (or redlines) that maps to the controls.

Can you send a single bundle we can attach to the PO? We prefer a dated runbook and any checklists. If you have an authoritative contact for a follow-up call with Security/Legal, please include them.

From: chloe.martin@redwood.com

Date: 2029-11-15T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Can you provide proof of EU-only inference + SCCs-bound operator controls?

Hi Michael —

Thank you — appreciate the clear list. We're preparing a single bundle and a short live walkthrough for Security + Legal. At a high level:
- EU-only processing: We will pin your tenant to our Frankfurt (eu-central-1) region and enforce routing at the load balancer and control plane level. In case of regional capacity issues we have a strict fallback policy that can only fail over to an EU secondary (Amsterdam) pool; non-EU failover is disabled for accounts that opt into "EU-only".
- SCCs: We include SCCs (EU Annexes) by default for the hosted contract; we can supply the signed SCC attachments and our subprocessor list.
- Operator access: Access to KV caches, raw request logs, and model administration is logged in our audit system and gated by role-based entitlements. We have a documented approval workflow for emergency remote access that requires 2-person approval and is timeboxed; operator sessions are recorded.

I'm attaching a first-pass runbook (redwood_eu_geofencing_runbook_v1.pdf), an SCCs checklist (sccs-implementation-checklist.xlsx), and a draft contract redline to map the controls you requested. Naomi (cc'd) is our compliance lead and can join the walkthrough; are you available for a 30-min call tomorrow morning CET?

Next steps I propose:
1) I send the bundle now (attached).
2) Quick 30-min call to walk Security through the failover and operator approval process.
3) We turn any contract redline into a DocuSign for signature.

Regards,
Chloe Martin

Subject: Internal: what to include in runbook + evidence items

Chloe — quick internal checklist before we finalize the bundle for BioPharm:
- Include network routing schematic (LB -> region tag -> infra pool), with explicit CIDR/region tags and failover conditions. Vivek, can you drop a minimal diagram?
- Evidence of SCC apply: signed Annex + timestamped publication page (legal copy). Naomi, attach the signed SCC annex and subprocessor registry snapshot.
- Logs & retention: state we retain operator/session logs for 90 days by default, and can extend on request — include an example audit excerpt (redacted).
- Emergency access: include who signs off (roles), ticketing ID format, and sample approval email. This is often what Legal reads for scope.

Also flag the contract redline items: 1) explicit EU-only processing clause, 2) operator access clause w/ 2-person emergency approval, 3) deletion/erasure SLA (30 days for primary tenant data; backups & held snapshots process described). Naomi — confirm the 30-day erase SLA language and whether we need to caveat for legal holds.

I'll turn this into the final PDF. Need to send before EOD CET tomorrow.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Michael —

Attached is the package we discussed:
- redwood_eu_geofencing_runbook_v1.pdf — 6 pages, includes routing schematic, failover matrix (primary Frankfurt -> secondary Amsterdam), and operator access workflow with sample approval.
- sccs-implementation-checklist.xlsx — shows the Annex that applies, subprocessor snapshot (redacted), and the steps we take to keep SCCs current.
- redwood-inference-contract-redline.docx — draft redline mapping the EU-only clause + operator access and deletion SLA.

Key confirmations for your team:
- Geo-fencing & routing: your tenant will be pinned to eu-central-1. We will not fail over outside EU. In scheduled maintenance scenarios we may route traffic to another EU pool; all such events are logged and notified in advance.
- SCCs: we will execute the standard SCC Annex and provide the signed copy.
- Operator access: operator sessions to admin consoles and KV caches require 2-person approval and are recorded; logs retained for 90 days (can be extended contractually).
- Deletion: primary tenant data removed within 30 days of a deletion request; backups are purged within 90 days unless placed on legal hold.

Next steps:
1) Naomi is available to walk Security/Legal through the runbook tomorrow at 10:00 CET (we reserved that slot). Please confirm attendees.
2) If the redline looks OK, Legal Ops can use the DocuSign link we shared to accept the changes and we will countersign.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call now if anything is unclear.

Best,
